title: Round 36's build faults: photos swapped in a block, nothing hidden, words on a placed photo judged with their tone, the copy writer's thinking off and its buttons knowing where they go, and checks that read a repeat or a renamed term as a visitor does
steps: S1: a WordPress block with an image block (srcset, wp-image-35, "id":35) and a background url(); blocks:{"0":{pictures:{…}}} with and without attachmentId.
S3: copy.apply with an AMBIGUOUS that names no pair, a NOT_EDITABLE pair and a COMPONENT_BAD_RESPONSE; copy.write then copyWritten.
S4: dark words over a dark photo the build placed, unreadable at baseline over the template's photo; the same over the template's own photo.
S5: one photo behind a feature card and in a strip 2,300 px below; then 600 px below. Titles "Happy Hour 1/2/3" with a brief saying happy hour.
S6: a post row's list:tags fish → menus; an EmDash picture {id: ULID, alt}; a template picture no record holds; a record with its identity holding the picture.
S7: copy calls to api.deepseek.com and to openrouter.ai refusing the reasoning field; button blocks to /contact/, /investors, tel: and another site.
expect: S1: the new path with origin kept, no srcset/sizes, wp-image-301 and "id":301; without attachmentId neither class nor id; words untouched.
S2: the five hiding values refused naming the gettext and block doors; the other two pass.
S3: the first again with all:"page", the second with all:true, the third under notPlaced; copy.write answers running at once, copyWritten polls to the pages.
S4: fails with fix image.tone "light"; over the template's own photo it keeps its exemption.
S5: far apart passes, near fails; the three numbered titles fail, "Suite 12" alone does not.
S6: pass; pass; in.setting names the setting road; in.swap names content.update blocks pictures.
S7: thinking {type:disabled}; reasoning {enabled:false} then asked again without it; to: /contact/, /investors, phone, another site.
evidence: Local round 36 (26/10/2026): WordPress 32 min, failed after 8 checks (19 blocks retyped for their photos, banner and "Most Read" hidden with display:none, a dark line on a dark placed photo unjudged); EmDash 26 min, passed at check 7 after 4 checks on {id, alt} pictures; Joomla 30 min, failed after 8 checks (copy JSON cut by the model's reasoning, far-apart repeats, "Happy Hour 1/2/3").

tests: {pictures} swaps a picture in a block — img, srcset, url() and its attachment — without retyping it
a look value that hides something is a build's refusal; one that shows or colours is not
an unnamed AMBIGUOUS goes again with all:"page"; a NOT_EDITABLE pair with all:true; others stay set aside
copy.write starts the copy tasks and answers at once; copyWritten polls them until they answer
contrast-readable judges words over a picture against the worst of what lies under them, at both widths
photos-fit skips carousel copies, sees a photo under words, and keeps the repeats the template has
no-demo-words: template titles differing only by a number fail even when the brief has their words
the baseline keeps each page's words in order, headings and buttons marked, forms and nav left out
a WordPress tag renamed is the same tag; a post given more tags differs
EmDash: a picture written as its library id with its alt is the same picture; another object is not
picturesWhere names the record and the WordPress block of each template picture, numbered as the outline is
a copy call switches the model's thinking off, and asks again without the field when a provider refuses it
a button keeps where it goes into the page tasks, shared or not, and the prompt says booking words need it
media.import on EmDash answers the library item’s id to write into a picture field
